title: Projection trace identity trace(p_T(I − p_S)) = ½|p_T − p_S|²
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let T, S be linear subspaces of ℝ^P with dim T = dim S; let p_T, p_S be the orthogonal projections onto T and S (Submodule.starProjection), I the identity and e_1, …, e_P the standard basis (EuclideanSpace.single i 1). Then trace(p_T ∘ (I − p_S)) = ½ Σ_{i=1}^{P} |p_T e_i − p_S e_i|², i.e. trace(p_T(I − p_S)) = ½|p_T − p_S|² for the Hilbert–Schmidt norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ T = Module.finrank ℝ S → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - S.starProjection).toLinearMap) = 1 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin P, ‖T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
